Dear front-counter team,
Lounge space, late last night: a short note from our desk

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through the late shift. The handoff notes were clear, and the care plans stayed easy to follow because the details were recorded with attention to species, temperament, and comfort. That kind of consistency helps us keep arrivals calm and makes the whole service feel dependable for travelers and their animals.

Please continue to place any kennel or lounge updates directly into the shared record before the end of your shift, even when the desk is busy. <<FACT F028>> The same applies to the pet lounge notes, since a careful entry helps the next person settle the animal without extra stress. <<FACT F001>> When a traveler asks for reassurance, a brief and steady reply is usually enough, and it helps keep the exchange warm without adding confusion.

If you notice a change in behavior, feeding, or mobility, record it in plain language and flag it for the senior coordinator. Small observations matter, especially when a pet is adjusting to a new environment or needs extra comfort during transfer. Our goal at Aurelia Skyways is to keep companion travel predictable, respectful, and calm for every guest, and your notes are a large part of that effort. Thank you for the care you show every night.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
